$comment: Triaged squirrelscan findings the scheduled site audit must not re-report. Fingerprints come from scripts/site-audit-diff.mjs; '<rule> :: *' covers every finding of a rule. verdict: false-positive (rule is wrong here), accepted (true but intended), tracked (an open issue owns it; drop the entry when the issue is fixed).

known.reason: Class-name heuristic that cannot resolve Tailwind tokens; every item says 'may have'. Real contrast is enforced by axe WCAG AA on every route in the browser gate (tests/e2e/site.e2e.ts).
Heading anchors are aria-hidden with tabindex=-1, the accepted pattern. axe aria-hidden-focus in the browser gate covers real regressions.
Every post renders its date in a visible <time> in ArticleHero; the rule flags some posts and not others with identical markup.
Image sits several paragraphs into designing-for-the-operator, below the fold on every viewport.
Astro emits one render-blocking CSS bundle by design; the asset hash changes per build.
Long articles put every paragraph in one prose container; 70-80 children is not a performance problem.
Blog index is a listing page, not content.
Markup weight is the terminal design; agents get clean content from /llms.txt.
Not useful for a portfolio and blog; /llms.txt covers agents.
Static S3 hosting cannot negotiate Accept: text/markdown; /llms.txt covers agents.
About is the #about section of the homepage.
Contact is the #contact section of the homepage.
Personal site: the publisher is the person, not an organization.
